review.why: Designs automated email sequences (welcome, nurture, onboarding, win-back) with timing, subject lines, copy rules and a no-AI-tells check.
review.summary: Asks for trigger, audience and goal, then sets length and timing by sequence type and gives a day-by-day outline for each. It lists lifecycle email categories, copy structure and tone, length targets and CTA rules, and bans stock phrases and fake reply subject lines. Output is a sequence overview, each email in full and a metrics plan.
strengths: One email, one job, one main call to action
Specific email-specific tells to avoid, such as fake Re: subjects
Reads prior learnings so tested angles are not proposed again
cautions: Timing and length figures are rules of thumb
Templates and lifecycle audit are in files not read here
Does not cover sending infrastructure or deliverability
